name: moveout-chain
about: Tom wants a hoodie in size M and has nothing to trade. Ana wants a TI-84 and would pass on her hoodie. Ravi wants a desk and would pass on his TI-84. Nobody can trade until Maya, moving out, lists her desk as a giveaway: it starts a 3-step chain, desk to Ravi, TI-84 to Ana, hoodie to Tom.

people.name: Tom Becker
people.says: Looking for a hoodie, size M. I don't have anything to trade.
people.reasons: Just moved from Seattle and it's cold in the lecture halls.

people.name: Ana Lopez
people.says: I have a hoodie, size M, good condition. Need a TI-84 calculator.

people.name: Ravi Iyer
people.says: Have a TI-84, need a desk. I'd want at least $41 for the calculator.
people.reasons: I passed MAT 265 and I study on my bed.

people.name: Maya Chen
people.says: Moving out Sunday, giving away a desk for free.
people.reasons: My lease ends and the desk won't fit in the car.
